instruction: Pick up the two T-shaped blocks, swap their positions, and place them back with the correct orientations.

arguments.note: I will use downward grasps and preserve the original poses: pink stem points back slightly right, blue stem points back-right more strongly.

calls.tool_result: Accepted: the original plan contains 31 control steps; only its first 20 will execute before the next observation. The remaining steps will not execute automatically. This prefix may end before the target or before a scheduled gripper change; the next observation reports actual execution and target error.

arguments.note: The first rotation stopped early; finish it while approaching above the two blocks.

calls.tool_result: Accepted: playing 19 waypoints (0.8s). The next observation reports how close the grasp point landed.

arguments.note: Both blocks are clearly visible. Approach their narrow stems from above, keeping clearance before final alignment.

calls.tool_result: Accepted: playing 6 waypoints (0.2s). The next observation reports how close the grasp point landed.

arguments.note: The hands stopped short, apparently crowding each other. Move the right hand aside so the left can align without interference.

arguments.note: Align the left jaws across the pink stem, with the other hand safely clear.

arguments.note: The pink stem is nearly centered between the jaws; correct five millimetres laterally and descend to just above grasp height.

arguments.note: The stem remains centered. Descend five millimetres before closing.

arguments.note: The jaws stopped against the stem. Lift vertically to verify a secure grasp.

calls.tool_result: Accepted: playing 3 waypoints (0.1s). The next observation reports how close the grasp point landed.

arguments.note: Pink is securely lifted. Hold it aside while the right hand picks up blue, remembering the pink grasp pose near (-0.040, -0.149) at yaw -15 degrees.

calls.tool_result: Accepted: playing 10 waypoints (0.4s). The next observation reports how close the grasp point landed.

arguments.note: Approach blue's stem with jaws rotated to its roughly 45-degree orientation.

arguments.note: Refine the blue alignment by a few millimetres; its stem angle is closer to -45 degrees.

calls.tool_result: Accepted: playing 2 waypoints (0.1s). The next observation reports how close the grasp point landed.

arguments.note: Blue's stem is centered and parallel to the jaws. Lower five millimetres and grasp.

calls.tool_result: Accepted: playing 7 waypoints (0.3s). The last 6 move the gripper, once the arm has arrived. The next observation reports how close the grasp point landed.

arguments.note: Lift blue vertically before translating or rotating it.

calls.tool_result: Accepted: playing 4 waypoints (0.2s). The next observation reports how close the grasp point landed.

arguments.note: Carry blue into pink's remembered position and rotate it thirty degrees to match pink's original orientation.

calls.tool_result: Accepted: playing 13 waypoints (0.5s). The next observation reports how close the grasp point landed.

arguments.note: Blue is over pink's former slot. Lower toward the table, stopping short of contact.

calls.tool_result: Accepted: playing 3 waypoints (0.1s). The next observation reports how close the grasp point landed.

arguments.note: Approach the support surface in five-millimetre increments.

arguments.note: Lower blue another five millimetres while preserving its swapped pose.

calls.tool_result: Accepted: playing 1 waypoints (0.0s). The next observation reports how close the grasp point landed.

arguments.note: Return blue to its original resting height and release it in pink's former pose.

calls.tool_result: Accepted: playing 6 waypoints (0.2s). The last 5 move the gripper, once the arm has arrived. The next observation reports how close the grasp point landed.

arguments.note: Blue is released. Lift the empty right hand clear before moving it aside.

calls.tool_result: Accepted: playing 11 waypoints (0.4s). The next observation reports how close the grasp point landed.

arguments.note: Move the empty right arm toward home, clearing the path for pink's placement.
